name: Somalia

flag.description: A light blue field with a large white five-pointed star in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The blue was inspired by the United Nations flag and represents the sky and ocean; the five points of the star represent the five regions inhabited by Somali people.

hook: Somalia is a single white star on UN sky blue, one point for each region where Somalis live.
trivia: The flag was designed in 1954 by Mohammed Awale Liban, while Somalia was a UN trust territory.
Somalia has the longest coastline of any country on mainland Africa.
